This thread is the public coordination surface for Aftergraph priorities across research, standards, runtime, products, and community work.

The roadmap is gate-driven rather than date-driven. Stronger claims require stronger evidence, and each repository remains authoritative for its exact implementation and release state.

Current public themes:
- independent MISSION-Bench reproduction and falsification,
- portable Mission Contract / SPEC-001 semantics,
- AIE independent implementations and conformance,
- enforceable authority, budgets, recovery, evidence and verification,
- Sentinel exact-HEAD verified review,
- public docs, discussion routing and reproducible contribution paths.

Canonical roadmap document:
https://github.com/Aftergraph/.github/blob/main/PUBLIC-ROADMAP.md

Use this thread to challenge ordering, identify missing user/research needs, propose measurable milestones, or show evidence that a priority should be narrowed or removed.

Please link concrete implementation tasks to the owning repository rather than turning this thread into a 900-item checkbox graveyard.
